name: blackswan-lowvol
description: The LOW-VOLATILITY / BETTING-AGAINST-BETA probe (Baker-Haugen; Frazzini-Pedersen 2014) — one of the most-cited 'it survives' claims: low-risk assets earn higher risk-adjusted returns, so a book LONG the low-risk / SHORT the high-risk names earns alpha. Ranks the survivorship-free diversified panel (7 commodities + SPY/TLT/IEF/UUP, daily from 2006) by a PAST-only risk score — trailing realised volatility (low-vol anomaly) or trailing beta to the equal-weight basket (BAB) — and holds a dollar-neutral long-low / short-high book (lowrisk), or its exact negation (lowrisk_inverse, the mirror control), rebalanced monthly and turnover-costed. Market-neutral, so the decider is the DSR-deflated oos_sharpe across a MAJORITY of the 17 deep-history windows. Score is past-only, book applied next bar, holes never forward-filled. Deterministic and model-free. PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATION: refutation net of cost OOS. DATA: commodities/<SYM>-1d-*.json + etfs/<SYM>-1d-*.json.

universe.description: The survivorship-free basket ranked by risk. diversified = 7 commodities + SPY/TLT/IEF/UUP, matching tsmom/xsmom so all anomaly probes share one panel.

signal.description: lowrisk longs the k lowest-risk / shorts the k highest-risk names (the published rule); lowrisk_inverse is the exact negation (mirror control). Dollar-neutral either way. An unknown value is refused.

rank_by.description: beta ranks by trailing beta to the equal-weight basket (Betting-Against-Beta); vol ranks by trailing realised volatility (the low-volatility anomaly). Both past-only; the two ranks are collinear on this basket.

span.description: The trailing window (bars) for the past-only risk score. 63 ~ 3m, 126 ~ 6m, 252 ~ 12m.

k.description: How many names on each side (long k lowest-risk / short k highest-risk). With an 11-asset basket k=3 leaves 5 flat; a universe with fewer than 2k names declines to trade.

rebalance_days.description: Bars between re-rankings (21 ~ monthly). Turnover — and therefore cost — scales with this.

transaction_fee.description: Per-unit-of-turnover cost charged both ways (~0.1% round trip) — realistic for liquid futures/ETFs.

walk_forward_window.description: Which out-of-sample year is ACCOUNTED. A real low-risk edge must clear DSR-Sharpe in a MAJORITY of these 17 years, not one.

seed.description: Present for contract conformance only — the screen is fully deterministic, so seeds are not swept.
